sub_site: blood (TCGA colorectal cancer patients, blood-derived WGS/RNA-seq)

data_source.dataset: TCGA CRC blood microbiome (rep200 decontaminated data from prior study, ref 18)

evidence.quote: The microbiome data were derived from prior cancer microbiome studies, including whole-genome and transcriptomic sequencing data of CRC from TCGA
alignment of non-human reads to the multi-domain “rep200” reference database for microbial quantification

decontamination.tool: in silico statistical contaminant identification + manual curation (prior TCGA pipeline)

evidence.quote: application of a robust two-step in silico decontamination strategy, which combined statistical identification of contaminants with manual curation against known human microbiome datasets

notes: Only 6 bacterial genera (plus Simplexvirus) selected by LASSO Cox for prognosis; decontaminated data inherited from prior study (decontamination done by original authors).
